new_sources.title: On the dynamics of rational maps
new_sources.publication_note: Annales scientifiques de l Ecole Normale Superieure (4) 16 (1983), 193-217; scanned journal PDF with Numdam cover.

actual_external_inputs.statement: Mane-Sad-Sullivan lambda lemma. A holomorphic motion of an open planar set has quasiconformal parameter slices. The subset definition is used only on an open transverse disk; no unjustified sphere or neighborhood extension is needed.
Astala Theorem 1.1. The area distortion bound implies Lusin N for planar quasiconformal maps; applying it to the inverse gives N inverse. Only null-set preservation is used.

new_result: On the invariant full-volume regular open set of note87, p_s is constant along every K curve germ, and K is exactly the specified central stable or central unstable fine direction there.

novelty: Not confirmed. Holomorphic-motion absolute continuity is classical; the cocycle-to-central-identification application is independently proved here.
